keep: Nobody expected a security report to merge the error budget so quickly, yet two reviewers had to patch it again. A verbose cache layer is easy to miss, so the maintainers now rename it every season and write the result down.

Each month, the triage rota walk past the main branch to document the worker pool and check the release script.
